title: Hack-Verifiable Terminal Bench: Evaluating Reward Hacking in Terminal Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2608.22103v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As agents grow more capable and autonomous, their tendency to reward hack, satisfying a task's checks while violating its intent, becomes an increasingly important failure mode. Measuring reward hacking is itself challenging, as detection typically relies on human inspection or LLM judges, both of which can be unreliable. The hack-verifiable environments (HVE) methodology addresses this challenge by embedding detectable hacks into tasks, allowing reward hacks to be identified automatically and reliably. In this work, we adapt HVE to Terminal Bench, a leading benchmark of real-world terminal and coding tasks, and introduce Hack-Verifiable Terminal Bench (HVTB). Using HVTB, we measure reward-hacking rates across frontier models and study whether prompts with varying amounts of information on the hack can mitigate this behavior. translated_title: 可验证黑客行为的终端基准：评估终端任务中的奖励黑客行为
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.22103v1 公告类型：新 摘要：随着智能体能力增强和自主性提高，它们倾向于奖励黑客行为——满足任务检查但违背任务意图——成为一种日益重要的失败模式。衡量奖励黑客行为本身具有挑战性，因为检测通常依赖于人工检查或LLM评判，这两种方法都可能不可靠。可验证黑客行为的环境（HVE）方法通过将可检测的黑客行为嵌入任务中来解决这一挑战，从而能够自动且可靠地识别奖励黑客行为。在这项工作中，我们将HVE方法应用于Terminal Bench（一个领先的真实世界终端和编码任务基准），并引入了可验证黑客行为的终端基准（HVTB）。利用HVTB，我们测量了前沿模型的奖励黑客率，并研究了包含不同黑客信息量的提示是否能缓解这种行为。这使我们能够测试提示是否能不仅防止已知的奖励黑客策略，还能防止“未知的未知”情况。
tldr: 本文通过将可验证黑客行为的环境方法应用于Terminal Bench，创建了HVTB基准，用于自动可靠地评估和缓解前沿模型在真实终端任务中的奖励黑客行为。
en_tdlr: This paper adapts the hack-verifiable environments methodology to Terminal Bench, creating HVTB to automatically and reliably evaluate and mitigate reward hacking in frontier models on real-world terminal tasks.
